## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to SMS Forwarder.

## Motivation
Why would this feature be useful? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of how you want the feature to work.

## Alternatives
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Implementation Ideas (Optional)
If you have ideas on how this could be implemented, please share them here.

## Would You Like to Implement This?
- [ ] Yes, I would like to implement this feature
- [ ] No, I would prefer the maintainers to implement it

If you'd like to implement it, please mention this in a comment and we can provide guidance.
